name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones

description: Active Noise Cancellation with Adaptive Transparency. Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking. Up to 30 hours total listening time.

description: Quantum Dot technology for over a billion shades of color. Neo Quantum Processor 4K for upscaling lower resolution content. Alexa and Google Assistant built-in.

description: 8K DPI on any surface. Ultra-fast MagSpeed electromagnetic scrolling. Ergonomic shape with customizable buttons. USB-C charging.

description: Modern slim silhouette crafted from stretch cotton for all-day comfort. Mid-rise waist, zip fly, and two front slash pockets.

description: Laser detects dust particles invisible to the naked eye. Automatically adapts suction power across floor types. 60-minute run time. HEPA filtration.

description: 7-in-1 multi-use: pressure cooker, slow cooker, rice cooker, steamer, sauté, yogurt maker, and warmer. 6-quart capacity. 13 built-in programs.

description: 24-inch HD touchscreen rotates for off-bike workouts. Auto-follow resistance adjusts in real-time. Apple GymKit compatible. Includes 30-day Peloton membership trial.

description: Responsive foam midsole with Nike Air unit in the heel. Breathable engineered mesh upper. Rubber outsole with waffle pattern for multi-surface traction.

description: Proven framework for improving every day. James Clear distills the most fundamental information about habit formation to help you achieve extraordinary results. Hardcover, 320 pages.

name: The Pragmatic Programmer 20th Anniversary
description: Covers topics from personal responsibility and career development to architectural techniques for flexible, adaptable code. Two prefaces, updated tips, and fresh phrasing. Paperback, 352 pages.

name: Kindle Paperwhite (16 GB)
description: Adjustable warm light and 300 ppi glare-free display. 16GB storage, weeks of battery life. Waterproof design (IPX8). Includes 3 months of Kindle Unlimited.

name: Weber Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill
description: Three stainless steel burners, porcelain-enameled cast-iron grates. GS4 high-performance grilling system. iGrill 3 compatible. 529 sq in total cooking area.

name: Under Armour HOVR Phantom Running Shoes
description: UA HOVR technology for a 'zero gravity feel' to maintain energy return. Connected (Bluetooth) for automatic workout tracking via MapMyRun app. Knit upper construction.
